description: This file defines a custom adapter for a RecyclerView used in onboarding screens of an Android app. It manages onboarding pages with images and text descriptions.

classes.name: OnboardingPagerAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for onboarding pages, managing view creation and binding.

classes.name: PageViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class holding references to views in each onboarding page.

classes.name: OnboardingPage
classes.description: Data class representing a single onboarding page with image and text resource IDs.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new PageViewHolder instance.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data from the pages list to the ViewHolder.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of onboarding pages.

methods.name: PageViewHolder.bind
methods.description: Binds an OnboardingPage's data to the view components.
